title: Investor Risk Tolerance & Age-Based Rule of Thumb
content: Risk profiling assesses an investor's willingness and financial capacity to withstand market drawdowns. The '100 Minus Age' rule suggests Equity Allocation % = (100 - Current Age). Adjustments based on risk profile: Conservative (lower equity by 15-20%), Moderate (standard 100-age allocation), Aggressive (increase equity by 15-20%). Portfolios must be aligned with investment time horizons.
